Title: CoA addon update 1.1
Body:
Adds DungeonClear with controls to start, pause, stop and check a bot-led dungeon clear. Type /dc to open the panel. Use a character level 15 or above to queue through Dungeon Finder; once your party includes a bot tank and is inside the dungeon, press On to begin.

Close the game before selecting Check updates in RealmVoyager. Launcher 1.4 updates itself to the version supporting this addon; older launchers need the current launcher replacement first.

Now included: Bagnon, Bagnon_Config, Bagnon_Forever, Bagnon_Tooltips, Blizzard_ArenaUI, Blizzard_BarbershopUI, Blizzard_BattlefieldMinimap, Blizzard_Calendar, Blizzard_GMSurveyUI, Blizzard_GlyphUI, Blizzard_TimeManager, Blizzard_TokenUI, Blizzard_TradeSkillUI, CoAPawn, CoASupportGuard, DragonUI, DragonUI_Options, DungeonClear, EsteriaAppearanceCache, Pawn, Questie-X, Questie-X-AscensionDB, Questie-X-CoADB, Questie-X-WotLKDB.

Close the game and click Check updates in RealmVoyager. The latest package includes earlier addon updates.

PREVIOUS UPDATE

Bots stay until you leave the dungeon

Dungeon Finder bots now stay after all required bosses are defeated, giving you time to loot. Use Leave Dungeon when you are ready to dismiss them. Completion rewards are still granted when the last required boss dies, and remaining combat must finish before the bots leave.

PREVIOUS UPDATE

Dungeon completion requires a full boss clear

Dungeon completion now waits until every regular boss in your selected dungeon or wing has been defeated. Rare spawns and optional summoned bosses are not required.

PREVIOUS UPDATE

Hunters start with Auto Shot

New classic Hunters now learn Auto Shot automatically from level 1. Missing Auto Shot has also been restored for Maximlin and Erla. With Auto Attack/Auto Shot enabled in Combat settings, right-click an enemy within bow or gun range to begin firing.

PREVIOUS UPDATE

Darkmoon Faire is always open

Darkmoon Faire is now open all the time in Elwynn Forest, Mulgore and Terokkar Forest. All three locations appear as ongoing events in the calendar. Reconnect and reopen your calendar to refresh it.
